title: Raising BER from G to A: Comprehensive Irish Retrofit Guide
summary: A practical step-by-step roadmap for Irish homeowners upgrading older properties from BER G to A rating using SEAI grants.

sections.heading: Step 1: Fabric First Insulation
body: Before installing high-efficiency heat pumps or solar arrays, seal your thermal envelope. External wall insulation, attic insulation, and floor insulation prevent up to 40% of heat loss.

sections.heading: Step 2: Heat Pump Integration
body: Replacing oil or gas boilers with a modern air-to-water heat pump dramatically boosts efficiency, lowering SCOP energy usage and qualifying for maximum SEAI grant support.
